from asyncio import gather
async def run(groups, read):
    for batch in groups:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await gather(*(read(item) for item in batch))
    for batch in groups:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await inspect(batch)
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await gather(*(read(item) for item in batch))
